scripts.start:dev: concurrently "npm --workspace packages/backend run start:dev" "npm --workspace packages/frontend run start:dev"
scripts.linux:install: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:24-bullseye npm install
scripts.linux:ci: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:24-bullseye bash -lc "npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build"
